colour_method: FFmpeg signalstats on the final mp4, averaged over all frames: YAVG (8-bit luma, Y plane, limited range 16-235) and SATAVG (8-bit chroma saturation). HSV saturation in percent is a different scale (about 2.3x SATAVG) and is not used for the checks.
notes: Loudness numbers are carried over from earlier work, not measured on this style. Cut, shot, caption, colour and blur numbers were measured on reference shorts (brightness 103-134, saturation 24-48, soft or blurred frames 6-67 percent per video); push share and soft-focus share are estimates.
